page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut title border with two standing figures flanking a central text panel; the title text lies within the panel. No running head, page number, catchword or signature visible.; One title page: the engraved frame with a printed text block at the top, a cartouche with the imprint in the centre, scroll texts left and right of it, and a banner text below the engraving. No running head or page number.

main_text.l: iuncta, effecta &c. pie, prudenter, dextre ac va-
rie explicantur, & non tantum dictis, & exem-
plis historiarum veterum ac recentium, ex sacris
scripturis, sanctis Patribus, seu Dd. Ecclesiæ,
rum tum Gentilium, sed etiam artificio-
Opusculum novum ac rarum, cuius usum atq; utilita-
Dura, ac præsenti fac Vincas mente labora.

page.notes: Woodcut border with a central garden vignette at top; two standing figures, a bishop on the left holding a crozier and book, and a crowned ruler on the right holding a sword and orb. The title is set in large capitals in the central panel, with the word VIRIDARIUM at the top. Part 1 of 2: the page continues beyond this part. The handwritten inscription at the lower left ("F. N. Schraj. 1757") is later handwriting and is left out. The engraving shows figures at a desk and a field scene; it is not transcribed. The right scroll line "veneran" / "dos" is cut at the edge of the scan, so the word division is uncertain.
